title: 搬送ストレッチャーの静的プロップ
description: 公共施設の救護室や医療施設の廊下を可視化するための、背の高い搬送ストレッチャー。長いマットレスと少し起きた頭部、開口のある左右の側柵、上下の台枠、交差した高さ支持材、シリンダーの外観、四輪キャスターと両端の押し手を造形しています。低い整備用クリーパーとは異なる高床の搬送機器シルエットです。人、患者、寝具、医療器具や別体の移乗補助具は含みません。全て固定された外観用モデルで、医療・搬送・昇降・拘束・ブレーキの機能、荷重定格や安全認証はなく、治療・製品設計・操作の指示ではありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.832 × 1.086 × 2.144 m、19,928三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A tall transfer-stretcher appearance prop for visualizing public first-aid rooms and healthcare corridors. Features a long mattress with slightly raised head section, open side rails, separate upper and lower chassis, crossed height-support struts, visual cylinder, four casters and pushing handles at both ends. Its high transfer-equipment silhouette is distinct from a low garage creeper. No person, patient, bedding, medical instruments or separate transfer aid is included. All parts are fixed, without clinical, transfer, lifting, restraint or braking function, load rating or safety certification. It provides no treatment, product-design or operating guidance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.832 × 1.086 × 2.144 m; 19,928 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
